adoption.rationale: The pinned config explicitly stores only the environment-variable name, and the receiver comment says the secret is resolved indirectly without logging the value. The identifier check precedes both indirect lookup and unset. Adoption covers only the accepted variable-name language and those two helper call sites.

declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; ASCII config strings usable as Bash variable names, unbounded length subject to the OS environment limit; contract covers both _resolve_secret at line 167 and _clear_webhook_secret_env at line 182, with line 167 as the indexed source site.
guarantee: The receiver resolves and unsets a configured secret environment variable only when its name is a Bash identifier: an ASCII letter or underscore followed by zero or more ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. Invalid names are rejected before indirect parameter expansion or unset.
input_source: Operator configuration from WEBHOOK_SECRET_ENV in the shell-sourceable webhook-receiver.conf or the documented environment override; this name selects which local environment variable holds the secret. The secret value itself is not the regex input.
